verdict.rationale: Stripe offers strong building blocks for this workflow — a full API/SDKs, an MCP server for AI agents (stripe-docs-13/28/39/55/61), a CLI and sandbox provisioning for agents (stripe-docs-16, stripe-docs-30, stripe-docs-32), and documented Payment Links creation (stripe-docs-4). This makes agent-driven creation of a product, price, and payment link plausible in one session, but there is no explicit end-to-end walkthrough or evidence confirming the MCP server exposes tools for creating Products/Prices/Payment Links specifically or that this full chain has been demonstrated hands-on. missing for 10: an explicit documented example or hands-on report of an agent using MCP/CLI to create a product+price+payment link in a single session, and confirmation that MCP tool coverage includes Payment Links creation.
